# He drops a bomb beside the pool (287) and runs back. The explosion (406) breaks the pool's side and the water
# drains; the Piranha, out of water, turns into a Fish Bone (407) above the pool's floor. oFishBone's create
# event sets myGrav = 0.2, and its step runs oItem's first, which adds it (yVel 0.2, 407) and then puts myGrav
# back to 0.6, so it falls 0.6 faster a step from the next (0.8, 1.4, 2, 2.6, 408-411). He picks the bone up
# (460), jumps out of the pool and throws it at the Snake (490), which it kills, breaking (491).
